hni_signals: VERY STRONG - LEADERSHIP, SCALE AND PUBLISHED PROCEDURE VOLUMES. Title is executive-clinical, not merely consultant: 'Clinical Director & Senior Consultant - CTVS, MICS & Heart Transplant Surgeon' at CARE Hospitals Banjara Hills, CARE's flagship Hyderabad cardiac campus. His arrival was significant enough for a dedicated press announcement, headlined 'Dr. Nagireddi Nageswara Rao Joins CARE Hospitals, Pioneering Advanced Cardiothoracic Surgery at CARE Banjara Hills' (30 May 2025) - a recruited marquee hire. PUBLICLY STATED PROCEDURE VOLUMES, quoted verbatim: 'more than 11,000 cardiac surgeries'; 'over 500 closed heart surgeries'; 'more than 350 lung surgeries, including advanced thoracoscopic procedures'; 'approximately 400 vascular surgeries'; his prior Yashoda profile stated 'over 10,000 heart surgeries', '300 thoracic and VATS procedures' and 'more than 200 vascular procedures'. FIRSTS AND PIONEER STATUS: 'first to implant third generation LVAD (HeartMate III) in South India in June 2016'; part of the team that performed 'the first heart transplantation in Telangana (2004)' and 'the first combined heart and kidney transplantation in India (2005)'. Premium ultra-high-revenue specialty - heart transplant, LVAD, MICS, complex aortic surgery. Elite training: MBBS Andhra Medical College Visakhapatnam 1986, MS General Surgery Andhra Medical College 1993, MCh Cardio-Thoracic & Vascular Surgery from NIMS Hyderabad 1996. SOCIETY MEMBERSHIPS: IACTS (Life Member, Indian Association of Cardiovascular and Thoracic Surgeons), VSI, VAI, SVS, HFSI, plus a member profile on CTSNet, the international Cardiothoracic Surgery Network. MEDIA / THOUGHT LEADERSHIP: featured clinician on CARE Hospitals' own podcast ('The World of Cardiac Surgery with Dr. Nagireddi Nageswara Rao') and on a Yashoda Hospitals video. INTERNATIONAL PATIENT FLOW: carries a Government of India Advantage Healthcare India (healinindia.gov.in) profile and a MediGence medical-value-travel listing.
